summary: Model Library blanks for ~20s on install/uninstall completion - full renderList re-creates every preview. User-reported regression.

Implementation started. Root cause traced before any edit and it is NOT the rebuild alone: renderList() wipes bodySlot, which DESTROYS every loaded preview element, and MpiTileSheet rebuilds them as loading="lazy" , so the replacements have no pixels and their load is deferred until after layout - behind a main thread pegged by _listSignature (O(n^2) _sharedOwnedDepIds per model) plus reSyncInstalledModels. That is the ~20s of blank tiles. LTX is worst for a second reason the card did not have: ltx23_high_preview.mp4 is 39.8MB, so preload=metadata must pull a moov atom out of it (5 models are video, not 1). Fix keeps the preview ELEMENTS alive across rebuilds: MpiTileSheet takes an optional previewCache Map, builds thumb media once per id and re-parents it, so an already-decoded element paints in the same frame and the grid never blanks. Covers every rebuild path (install, uninstall, filters, search, draft toggle, engine switch), not just the two reported. Rejected a keyed whole-grid diff: section moves cross sheet INSTANCES, so an honest diff means persisting 4 sheets + headers + per-tile reconcile inside a Primitive shared by 3 surfaces - far more blast radius for the same visible result. Also in scope: generated .webp posters for the 5 video previews, and the uninstall toast wording.

USER-VERIFIED LIVE - all five acceptance items, on a remote CPU Pod (the harshest case: a remote connect also fires renderList({force:true}) + awaitReSync()). Install of SDXL Realistic 9.0GB ran to completion: 4 installed/14 available -> 5/13, volume 139.4 -> 149GB, model moved Available -> Installed, every other tile kept its picture - that is the exact download:complete -> awaitReSync -> renderList path that used to blank for ~20s. Uninstall did the same and the card then moved back to Available. LTX 2.3 video tile painted its frame throughout both rebuilds, having previously been last to repaint every time. Toast read 'SDXL Realistic uninstalled.', not 'updated'. User words: no flickering and stopping with empty cards anymore. Sibling tiles showing a bar during the install were checked and are the MPI-258 shared-dep partial clearing on re-sync, not a regression - the user identified it as expected before it was raised. Noted and NOT from this work: the uninstall toast fires on download:uninstalled while the count and tile still read installed, because reSyncInstalledModels re-stats the dep universe over the network after ~9GB of deletion; the card did move correctly afterwards, so it is latency, not a stuck state - it was simply hidden inside the 20s of blank tiles before. Uncarded pending the user's call.
